product.ta-20-se.summary: The TA 20-SE was the office model with a single-element printer.
product.ta-20-se.history: Triumph-Adler offered it for office work alongside the dot-matrix TA 20-NP. The SE model sheet lists 8 KiB of RAM and an MBKE 2 cassette drive.
product.ta-20-se.technical.configuration: The cassette loaded office programs. The service manual describes BAB 02 or 04 boards and 3 or 8 KiB configurations.
product.ta-20-se.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-20-se.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
